 CBSE Class 12th Date Sheet 2027 Out, Download Class 12 Time Table PDF
 The CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 has been released for the board exams starting on 16 February and ending on 9 April 2027. Check subject-wise exam dates for Science, Commerce and Arts, exam timings, important instructions and steps to download the date sheet PDF. 
 Posted by Sanjeev Gupta November 13th, 2026 02:45 pm 
 Leave a comment on CBSE Class 12th Date Sheet 2027 Out, Download Class 12 Time Table PDF 
 The Official CBSE Class 12th date sheet 2027 is released on 6 November, 2026 . According to the timetable, the CBSE Class 12 theory examinations will start from 16 February 2027 and end on  9 April 2027 . 
 The examinations will be conducted for Science, Commerce and Arts/Humanities students. Major subjects include Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, English, History and Political Science, along with language and vocational subjects. The examination start time is 10:30 AM. Students can check the complete subject-wise CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027, important dates, examination timings and PDF download details below.

 Students should download the timetable and check the dates of all their registered subjects. They should also verify the subject codes to avoid confusion between subjects with similar names.

 CBSE Class 12 Practical Exam Date 2027 
 CBSE has issued a practical examination schedule for winter-bound schools for the 2026–27 academic session. The practical examinations, project assessments and internal assessments for these schools are scheduled from 9 November to 19 December 2026 . 
 For other CBSE-affiliated schools following the regular academic session, practical examinations and internal assessments are scheduled to begin from 1 January 2027 . Schools will inform students about their subject-wise practical examination dates. 
 Note: The winter-bound school schedule does not apply to every CBSE-affiliated school. Students should approach  their respective schools to know the practical examination schedule. 
 How to Download CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 PDF? 
 Follow these steps to download the CBSE Class 12 timetable from the official website: 
 Go to the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in . 
 Open the Latest @ CBSE or Examination section. 
 Find  the Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 link. 
 Click on the respective timetable PDF. 
 The date sheet will appear on the screen. 
 Check your subject names, examination dates and timings. 
 Download the PDF and save it on your device. 
 Take a printout  
 Students should have the latest timetable available through CBSE’s official website and check for any revised examination schedule.

 CBSE Class 12 Admit Card 2027
 After the release of the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027, students should also keep track of the board examination admit card. The admit card is an important document required to appear in the Class 12 board examinations. CBSE has not announced the release date of the regular Class 12 admit cards for the 2027 main examinations yet.
 Regular students will be able to collect their admit cards through their respective schools after CBSE makes them available. Private candidates should check the official CBSE website for admit card-related announcements and download instructions.
 Details Mentioned on CBSE Class 12 Admit Card
 Students should carefully check the following details after receiving their admit cards:
 Student’s name
 Roll number
 School name and school code
 Examination centre name and address
 Subject names and subject codes
 Examination dates and timings
 Student’s photograph
 Important examination instructions
 Students should immediately inform their school authorities if they find any incorrect information on their admit cards. They should also keep the admit card safe and follow all instructions mentioned on it during the examination period.
 How to Prepare for CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027 After the Date Sheet Release?
 After checking the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027, students should organise their remaining preparation according to their examination dates. A well-planned revision schedule can help students cover important topics and practise questions before each paper.
 Here are some useful and effective preparation steps students can follow:
 Prepare a Subject-Wise Calendar: Write down the examination dates of all registered subjects and arrange them in chronological order.
 Identify Difficult Subjects: Give additional revision time to subjects and chapters that require more practice.
 Complete the Syllabus: Try to complete the remaining syllabus before the examination period so that sufficient time is available for revision.
 Practise Sample Papers: Solve the latest CBSE Class 12 sample papers to understand the question pattern and marking scheme.
 Revise Important Topics: Prepare short notes, formulas, definitions and important concepts for quick revision.
 Use Exam Gaps Properly: Plan revision according to the time available between two examinations. Focus on the next upcoming subject instead of studying multiple subjects without a schedule.
 Check the Official Updates: Keep checking the CBSE website and school announcements for any changes in the timetable or examination instructions.
 Following these steps can help students organise their preparation and approach the CBSE Class 12 board examinations with better planning.
 Important Instructions for CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027 
 Students must follow the examination instructions issued by CBSE and also of their respective schools. Few important points are given below: 
 Download and check the latest date sheet before making  your final revision timetable. 
 Examine the subject codes and examination dates carefully. 
 Take your CBSE Class 12 admit card to the examination centre. 
 Reach the examination centre before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card. 
 Carry only permitted stationery items. 
 Do not carry mobile phones, smartwatches or other prohibited electronic devices. 
 Read the question paper instructions carefully. 
 Follow the instructions given by the examination staff.

 CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027: FAQs 
 Q 1. Is CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 released? 
 Ans. The Official CBSE Class 12th date sheet 2027 is released on 6 November, 2026 . 
 Q 2. When will the CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027 start? 
  Ans. CBSE Class 12 Board Examinations 2027 will start from 16 February 2027. 
 Q 3. What is the last date of the CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027? 
 Ans. 9 April 2027 is  the last examination date for Class 12 Board Exams. 
 Q 4. What is the CBSE Class 12 Physics exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Physics examination is scheduled for 16 February 2027. 
 Q 5. What is the CBSE Class 12 Chemistry exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Chemistry examination is scheduled for 27 February 2027. 
 Q 6. What is the CBSE Class 12 Mathematics exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Mathematics and Applied Mathematics examinations are scheduled for 9 March 2027. 
 Q 7. What is the CBSE Class 12 Accountancy exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Accountancy examination is scheduled for 23 February 2027. 
 Q 8. What is the CBSE Class 12 Business Studies exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Business Studies and Business Administration examinations are scheduled for 1 April 2027. 
 Q 9. What is the CBSE Class 12 Economics exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Economics examination is scheduled for 16 March 2027. 
 Q 10. What is the CBSE Class 12 Biology exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Biology examination is scheduled for 25 March 2027. 
 Q 11. What is the CBSE Class 12 English exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The English Core and English Elective examinations are scheduled for 5 March 2027. 
 Q 12. What is the CBSE Class 12 Political Science exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The Political Science examination is scheduled for 19 March 2027. 
 Q 13. What is the CBSE Class 12 History exam date 2027? 
 Ans. The History examination is scheduled for 27 March 2027. 
 Q 14. What time will the CBSE Class 12 Board Exams 2027 start? 
 Ans. The examinations will start at 10:30 AM. Students should check their admit cards for reporting time and other instructions.
 Q  15. Where can I download the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 PDF? 
 Ans. Students can visit the official CBSE website at cbse.gov.in to check the latest examination timetable and download the available PDF. 
 Q16. How many subjects are included in the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027? 
 Ans. The CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 covers examinations for 121 subjects, including academic, language and vocational subjects.
 Q17. How many days before the examination was the CBSE Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 released? 
 Ans. CBSE released the Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 on 6 November 2026, which was 101 days before the commencement of the board examinations.
 Q18. Did CBSE consider entrance examination dates while preparing the Class 12 timetable? 
 Ans. Yes. CBSE considered the tentative schedules of major entrance examinations while preparing the Class 12 board examination timetable.
 Q19. What should students do if their subject name is different from the one mentioned in the date sheet? 
 Ans. Students should check their registered subject name and subject code with their school. They should contact their school authorities if they find any discrepancy.
 Q20. Has CBSE announced the Class 12 Admit Card 2027 release date? 
 Ans. No. As of 13 November 2026, CBSE has not announced the release date of the regular Class 12 admit cards for the 2027 main examinations.
